assay: bulk RNA-seq (NextSeq 500, HISAT2/featureCounts mm9), mouse bone-marrow Lin-LEPR+ SSCs (FACS) and immuno-depleted cultured MSCs
primary_estimand: Effect of hindlimb unloading (HU, mechanical disuse) vs ambulatory (AMB) controls on SSC and MSC transcriptomes at 8wk and 14wk; plus SSC transcriptome after 8wk HU + 8wk reloading (HUR) vs age-matched AMB
sample_inclusion: One pooled RNA library per group: RNA pooled from 3-4 mice per group (S2.4.p1, S4.2.p1, S4.2.p2, S4.7.p1); 10 libraries total, no biological replicates
planned_contrasts: 8wk HU vs AMB in SSC (S2.4.p1; paper: 3991 DEGs)
8wk HU vs AMB in MSC (S2.4.p1; paper: 1504 DEGs)
14wk HU vs AMB in SSC and MSC (S2.5.p2; counts only in Supplementary Fig. 5d,e, 'fewer than 8wk')
HUR vs AMB SSC pseudo-time K-means clustering (S2.6.p2-p3; no DEG count)
repeated_measure_unit: none (pools of different mice per group)
paper_method: edgeR exact test with a FIXED dispersion of 0.2 (no replicates to estimate dispersion), TMM calcNormFactors, filter sum of counts > 2, protein-coding transcripts only (S4.8.p1)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S4.9.p1 (general 'p <= 0.05'); DEG rule for RNA-seq not stated in S4.8.p1; Fig. 3c-e highlight Log2FC > 2
